extension.summary: Live Arabic TV + YouTube Drama — Syrian, Lebanese, Egyptian, Iraqi, Jordanian
extension.description: Watch live Arabic TV channels and YouTube drama content. 7 live TV groups: Syrian, Lebanese, Egyptian, Iraqi, Jordanian, Arabic Drama & Movies, and Music. Plus YouTube sections for Syrian and Lebanese/Egyptian drama series including Bab Al Hara all seasons. 85+ live channels total. Made with love for Walaa.
extension.disclaimer: This addon uses publicly available streaming links from iptv-org and YouTube channels. The author does not host or stream any content. YouTube section requires the plugin.video.youtube Kodi addon.
